advice: Stand up and change position to interrupt prolonged sitting.
Take a brief walk to refill water or speak with a colleague.
Sit with your feet supported and your lower back supported by the chair.
Place the monitor directly in front of you with the top of the screen at or slightly below eye level.
Keep the keyboard and mouse close to your body with wrists in a neutral position.
Look away from the screen at a distant object and blink fully.
Perform slow, gentle neck and shoulder stretches, stopping if there is pain.
Use gentle movement to avoid prolonged rest.
Gently open and stretch your fingers and wrists during a short typing pause.
Take a brief break from computer tasks to relieve muscle tension and visual fatigue.
Breathe slowly through the nose and out through the mouth while sitting comfortably.
Maintain regular sleep times and drink enough water during the day.
Adjust screen brightness and text size and position the screen to reduce glare.
